runtime_observations: Apply control is a DIV with onclick; click by text or class .gnewtonApplyBtn.
Yes/No screening widgets are divs; do not look for radios. Question text precedes the widget within the same cell.
Resume upload lives in a separate form (#uploadResume) from the personal-info form.
Form element .id can be shadowed by an input named 'id' — read form ids via getAttribute.

provider_hint.for_jev: Paycor: multi-step. Some tenants first show a Yes/No screening questionnaire (remote readiness, time zones, OPT/CPT, minimum requirements, sponsorship, essential functions, I-9 documentation) then 'Continue'; others start with 'Apply with a Resume' (file/Drive/Dropbox/fax), Personal Information (first/preferred/last, email), Contact Information (mobile, address, city, state, zip), optional Comments textarea, required SMS opt-in Yes/No, required privacy acknowledgement checkbox, then 'Submit'. Later pages unobserved. Some employers embed the form on their own site in an iframe.

human_action_needed: Harvest Group: observe the form inside the employer-site iframe (needs frame-capable tooling); native tenants: a human must advance past Continue/Submit to reveal later steps.
